card.name: Adverse-event case reports in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "reported" after "have been" or "cases" after "Most of the" in warning text about adverse events. Also "within" before a time span after a reaction.

modes.label: Reported after have been
modes.description: The word "reported" right after "cases of myopathy ... have been" in drug interaction text.
modes.example: Cases of myopathy, including rhabdomyolysis, have been<< reported>> with simvastatin coadminister

modes.label: Most of the cases
modes.description: The word "cases" in a sentence about how many injury cases are tied to a drug use.
modes.example: Most of the<< cases>> of liver injury are associated with the use

modes.label: Onset timing
modes.description: The word "within" introducing how soon a reaction can occur.
modes.example: Tendinitis or tendon rupture can occur,<< within>> hours or days of starting a fluoro

card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where cases of a harm are being reported or counted.
